summary: First-pass independent review: 18/18 RAW files match PRIDE and MaxQuant experimentalDesignTemplate (B/L/M × Lys-C/Trypsin fractions). Technical metadata matches paper Methods (Q Exactive DDA HCD NCE25; camC; 6 ppm/20 ppm) and summary variable mods.

reviewer_context.context: fresh hook agent without producer transcript

spec_compliance.evidence: Templates ms-proteomics+vertebrates v1.1.0; parse_sdrf -t ms-proteomics -t vertebrates --use_ols_cache_only exit 0 with Swiss white strain warning only. Row shape 18×32; fraction 1=Lys-C / 2=Trypsin consistent.

ontology_integrity.evidence: UBERON brain/liver/skeletal muscle tissue; NCBITaxon:10090; adult EFO:0001272; Q Exactive MS:1001911; Lys-C MS:1001309 / Trypsin MS:1001251; UNIMOD camC/ox/acetyl. Strain Swiss white free text (documented).

source_evidence.evidence: PRIDE: adult Swiss white mice; brain/liver/skeletal muscle; MED-FASP Lys-C then trypsin; camC fixed. Paper (PMID 26080680 PDF): NCE 25; precursor ≤6 ppm; fragment ≤20 ppm; triplicates. summary.txt Variable modifications Oxidation (M);Acetyl (Protein N-term). experimentalDesignTemplate maps all 18 RAW to B*/L*/M*.

file_mapping.evidence: 18 unique RAW in SDRF = 18 PRIDE RAW files (plus Glycolysisupload.zip SEARCH held out). 0 mismatches vs experimentalDesignTemplate.txt names; tissue/enzyme/tech-rep cross-check 0 mismatches.

design_consistency.evidence: 3 tissues × 3 tech reps × 2 enzyme fractions = 18; biological replicate=1 (cohort-level; paper does not resolve one-vs-three mice); factor organism part only. Muscle May-batch Lys-C tech3 absent; June 97_L_* mapped to M2/M3 as in MaxQuant design.

omission_safety.evidence: Age/sex not available (not reported). Does not invent the paper's additional 7 organs/human cells into this RAW set. No unsupported disease/treatment factors.

deterministic_validation.evidence: parse_sdrf exit 0 (Swiss white warning); tools score 100/100. tools check OLS network false positives disregarded; official validator + primary sources used for ontology/source checks.

findings.message: Swiss white remains free text (validator warning).
